GET /v1/unions/pdd/auth-url answers HTTP 503 / 50301 with data.reason=maintenance when the site union authorization of the account actually used is unavailable (BR-ID-24 ④ 2026-10-08), before issuing a state or writing union_auth_sessions; Taobao keeps 30101 / 30102 auth_unavailable and 30153 is still judged first. Written by hand.
